people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
translations.bsb: Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.
translations.kjv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
translations.asv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: His excellency is over Israel, And his strength is in the skies.
